hook: Georgi Gerganov changed how large language models reach ordinary computers. Working from Sofia, Bulgaria, he built the ggml tensor library and then llama.cpp, a C and C++ inference engine that let Meta's LLaMA models run on a laptop through aggressive quantization instead of a data-center GPU. He founded ggml.ai in 2023 on pre-seed funding from Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross to sustain the project, and in February 2026 he and his team joined Hugging Face so llama.cpp would have long-term backing while staying fully open source.
name: Georgi Gerganov

quote.text: 65 billion parameters, you probably need about 40 gigs of RAM, with 4-bit quantization. So this can run on a MacBook. Why not do it?
quote.context: Changelog Interviews #532, Bringing Whisper and LLaMA to the Masses, 2023

primary.name: Hugging Face, GGML and llama.cpp join Hugging Face, February 20, 2026

timeline.impact: Demonstrates that quantized LLMs can run on a MacBook, helping start the local-LLM movement

timeline.event: Founds ggml.ai with pre-seed funding from Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross
timeline.impact: Gives the ggml tensor library project a formal company home

timeline.event: Joins Hugging Face with his team on February 20
timeline.impact: Secures long-term institutional backing for llama.cpp while keeping it community-driven and open source

quick_facts: Creator of ggml, whisper.cpp and llama.cpp, C and C++ libraries for running AI models on consumer hardware
Holds a physics degree with a master's in medical physics, per his interview on the Changelog podcast
Founded ggml.ai in 2023 with pre-seed funding from Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross
Based in Sofia, Bulgaria, per his GitHub profile
llama.cpp has passed 119,000 stars on GitHub
Joined Hugging Face with his team in February 2026 to continue leading GGML and llama.cpp development

achievements.title: Built ggml and llama.cpp
achievements.impact: Created the quantization and inference stack that made it possible to run large language models on ordinary laptops and phones instead of data-center GPUs.

achievements.title: Built whisper.cpp
achievements.impact: Ported OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model to efficient C and C++, extending the same consumer-hardware approach to audio transcription.

achievements.title: Founded ggml.ai, 2023
achievements.impact: Raised pre-seed funding from Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross to give the open-source project a sustainable home.

achievements.title: Joined Hugging Face, 2026
achievements.impact: Moved his team into Hugging Face to secure long-term resources for llama.cpp while keeping it fully open source, per Hugging Face's own announcement.
